_why: The pull requests this project holds open ON PURPOSE. Close-out PR5 says one open pull request at a time, and scripts/guards/one-pull-request-at-a-time.mjs enforces it by failing when more than ONE open pull request is unaccounted for. Three were open by decision on 9 September 2026 after the PR1 audit, each carrying work that is on main nowhere and is still wanted, so a bare count would have failed the build on day one for three pull requests the owner was told in writing would stay open. That guard gets switched off within a week, which is the decay CLAUDE.md already names for no-ai-authorship and branch-protection-required. So parking is allowed, and parking must be EXPLAINED: every entry carries why it is held and what ends the holding.
_rules: An entry naming a pull request that is no longer open is a FAULT, not a tidy-up: the record outlived its subject. An entry whose branch no longer matches the open pull request's head is a FAULT. An empty why or unblockedBy is a FAULT, because parking with no stated end is abandonment with better manners. The guard prints every entry on every run, so the list cannot rot into an unexamined allowlist.
_auditMethod: Close-out PR1. Each verdict rests on a file-by-file comparison of what the branch adds against what origin/main holds, never on the title.

parked.why: Adds docs/marketing/CONTENT-PLAN.md and docs/marketing/OUTREACH-TEMPLATES.md, both of which exist on main nowhere, so closing it loses them. Held rather than landed because the positioning ruling of 7 September 2026 retired the strapline both documents were written around, and landing marketing copy that contradicts the locked positioning would put the defect the positioning-lock guard exists to catch into the repository by hand.
parked.unblockedBy: Re-reading both documents against the locked positioning in CLAUDE.md, correcting what the ruling retired, then landing it as the single active pull request.

parked.why: Adds docs/SHOT-LIST.md, which is absent from main and is not duplicated by docs/PHOTO-DAY.md. Held because the shot list is written against a community and category taxonomy that C18 FINAL changed, so its slot counts are claims about a taxonomy that has since moved.
parked.unblockedBy: Photo day being scheduled, and the shot list's counts re-verified against docs/scope/community-layer-approved.json rather than against the taxonomy it was written for.

parked.why: Twenty five of its thirty files are absent from main, including the /music routes and the follow graph surfaces. Held because CLAUDE.md's Scene layer section parks exactly this work in its own words: missing scene landing pages are tracked for the post-photos taxonomy mission.
parked.unblockedBy: The post-photos taxonomy mission that CLAUDE.md's Scene layer section names, at which point the branch is rebased and gated as the single active pull request.
